name: DC Drop-In Mahjongg
description: Community playing American-style NMJL Mahjongg with free or low-cost instruction; recurring Tuesday sessions at Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library and Sunday sessions at the Capital Jewish Museum.
schedule: Tuesdays 6:00-8:00 PM at MLK Jr. Memorial Library; free lessons for new players require registration; open play is for all skill levels. Sunday American Mahjong sessions are also offered at Capital Jewish Museum when scheduled.

name: DC Mahj Collective
description: Washington DC American Mahjong business offering recurring Hill Center open play, beginner lessons and guided play, plus private and corporate lessons.
schedule: American Mahjong at Hill Center every other Wednesday; Open Play $20, Beginner Lesson $75, Guided Play $50. Additional recurring series listed on events page.
